senses.gloss:
शृध् {vI.v} {c1c} A. (but Paras. also in
the Second Future, Aorist, and
Conditional) (शर्धते) To break wind
downwards. {vII.v} {c1c} U. (शर्धति-ते)
1
To moisten, wet.
--2 To cut off.
{vIII.v} {c10c} U. (शर्धयति ते)
1 To strive.
--2 To take, grasp.
--3 To insult (as
by breaking wind), mock, ridicule.
